title: Would You Still Want Heaven If God Wasn't There? | Is Your Faith Just Fear Of Hell?
description:
Do you love God, or do you just not want to go to hell? A morning message and prayer on the question that exposes the heart.

Hell is real, but the worst of it is being cut off from every good thing God ever gave. Jesus said depart from me before He said fire. Augustine's two kinds of fear, John Piper's question about heaven without Christ, C. S. Lewis on the doors of hell, and the cross where Jesus was forsaken so you never would be.

Tonight at 8:30 PM Eastern: Heaven Is Where He Is, the night prayer that answers this question.

"Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee." Psalm 73:25 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): Matthew 10:28, 2 Thessalonians 1:9, Psalm 139:8, James 1:17, Matthew 5:45, Luke 16:24, Matthew 7:22-23, Matthew 25:41, Matthew 15:8, 1 John 4:18-19, Psalm 73:25-26, Psalm 16:11, John 17:3, Matthew 27:46, Romans 8:38-39, Revelation 2:4, Philippians 3:8, Psalm 84:10.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
